evidence: Pure black ground (#000) that never changes; every lit pixel is a hairline stroke or a solid round dot: no texture, no shading, no gradients

The tree is mathematically regular: every segment splits into exactly two, each child about 0.72 to 0.78 of its parent length, angles 0.27 to 0.44 rad either side; all segments of one level appear at the same moment (one level every 0.25 s)
Line width falls level by level (about 3 px trunk down to 1 px twigs); tip dots shrink level by level (about 16 px radius at the root dot down to 2 px)
Text is a single centred lowercase line in a geometric sans (Poppins-like), crisp, swapped in one frame at 2.5 s: an HTML overlay over a canvas
Deterministic 30 fps motion, no frame-to-frame noise: generated by code (canvas + timeline), not drawn or filmed
shots.description: One continuous code-rendered shot on pure black. 0.0 s: the lowercase line "[line one]" sits centred at y about 262 (44 px, near-white, regular weight); a solid white dot (radius 16 px) pops in at x 540, y 1400. 0.3 to 2.5 s: the dot draws a vertical hairline trunk 228 px up, then every 0.25 s each tip splits in two (9 levels, 256 tips); a white dot rides every growing tip, the dots getting smaller each level; the crown fans out into a wide dome from x about 75 to 970, y about 580 to 960, like a broad umbrella tree. 2.57 s (all tips landed): the line swaps to "[line two]" in one frame, all tips flash bigger and settle, the branches dim to about half opacity (grey), a thin grey ring expands from the root to radius about 280 px and fades, about 40 small dots drift up and outward off the crown and fade to grey specks; the whole tree sways gently, more at the tips, and settles. 4.0 s: end, crown of lit dots over a grey tree.

narrative.point: A one-dot-becomes-many picture makes a quiet two-part idea visible: the setup line while it grows, the turn line the moment it completes

style.render_style: Minimal black-and-white hairline line art drawn by code on a 2D canvas: pure black ground, thin white strokes, solid white dots, nothing filled except the dots
style.outline: Strokes only, no outlines around shapes: everything is a line (1 to 3 px, thinner level by level) or a solid dot
style.shading: None: no gradients, no glow, no shadows; depth only by line weight and opacity (finished lines dim to about 50% while the dots stay at full white)
style.shape_language: Straight segments and circles; a binary branching tree (two children per tip, length ratio about 0.75, split angle about 0.27 to 0.44 rad); one thin ring; tiny round specks
style.texture: None; the only grain is a scatter of small drifting dots (radius 3 to 5 px) that fade to grey
style.type_ui: One lowercase line, centred, near-white, regular weight geometric sans (Poppins 400), 44 px on 1080 wide, centre at y about 262, ending with a full stop; it swaps to a second line in one frame at the payoff; no boxes, no stroke, no shadow
style.motion_style: Calm and procedural: a dot appears, a line draws out of it with easeOut-cubic (0.27 s per segment), one new level every 0.25 s, so growth reads as a steady doubling; at completion a small bounce of the tip dots, a one-shot expanding ring, a slow damped sway; camera locked
style.signature: One white dot on pure black turning into many: hairlines that split in two at every step with a dot riding each tip, and one quiet lowercase line that changes when the drawing completes
style.do_not_copy: The two lines of text (its words), the tree as the only motif, the exact seed shape; named after a creator style, no handle or watermark in the frame

story.summary: A 4 s minimal line-art clip: one dot grows into a branching tree while a short lowercase line states a setup, and the line turns at the instant the drawing completes
story.hook: 0 s: a single white dot alone on black under one short lowercase line: the emptiness makes the eye wait for what the dot will do
highlights: 0.3 to 2.5 s: the drawing doubles at a steady beat (one level every 0.25 s), so the idea of one thing becoming many is felt, not explained
2.57 s: the text turns to its second line exactly when the last tips land, with a pulse ring and drifting sparks, so the words and the picture pay off together
Whole clip: pure black and hairline white only, one line of text, no boxes: the restraint makes it read as calm and thoughtful
